message.content: {"verdict": "not_supported", "passage": 1, "reason": "The source states the opposite: benefits of acute aerobic exercise were greater in participants with lower cognitive performance at pre-test, not only in those with high performance."}
message.reasoning_content:
The claim: "Acute aerobic exercise benefited only participants who had high cognitive performance at pre-test."

Passage [1] says: "the beneficial after-effects of acute aerobic exercise on cognitive performance were greater in participants with lower cognitive performance at pre-test."

This directly contradicts the claim — the claim says high performers benefited only, but the source says lower performers benefited more. So verdict: not_supported, passage 1.
